title: Pending manifest repair apply evidence
summary: Enabled backend-owned pending manifest repair for narrow manifest-normalization candidates by adding validated dry-run proposals, candidate-only safe-to-apply gating, backup-backed atomic manifest apply, tests, contract wording, active docs, inventories, and refreshed generated summaries.
reason: The Phase 4 remediation backlog exposed pending manifest repair apply routes but left them blocked because dry-run evidence did not supply complete backend-derived proposed manifest fields. The backend needed a dry-run-first, fingerprint-gated, manifest-only apply path that preserves source, payload, and output bytes while leaving unsafe pending/orphan cases blocked.
behavior_before: Pending manifest repair dry-run marked incomplete pending rows as review evidence and could list would-write paths without a complete proposed manifest. Confirmed pending manifest repair always failed with a hard block, and docs/contracts described the route as unavailable unless future backend evidence supplied complete proposed fields.
behavior_after: Pending manifest repair dry-run can build candidate rows only for backend-validated manifest normalization, currently filling missing array fields, copying an existing parked_file into local_file, and inferring output_size from the parked payload when that produces a valid pending_push_manifest.v1. Confirmed apply rewrites only selected candidate manifest JSON after matching fingerprint and strict confirmation, with backup and atomic write evidence. Incomplete pending evidence and orphan-payload reconciliation remain blocked and do not move, delete, drain, publish, or touch source/payload/output bytes.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_repair_reconcile_dry_run tests.python.desktop.test_repair_reconcile_apply tests.python.desktop.test_api_contract_payload tests.python.desktop.test_api_command_contracts tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api tests.webview.test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary -q - failed with one unrelated existing served-HTML assertion expecting data-network-tab="coordinator"; repair/reconcile-specific Local API tests passed by name
rollback_plan: Revert the pending manifest repair proposal/apply changes in src/mediapipeline/core/repair_reconcile/dry_run.py and apply.py, restore contract payload wording and docs/inventories to the prior blocked-pending-apply posture, remove the new repair/reconcile tests, and refresh generated summaries. Existing pending manifests written by this route can be restored from the per-transaction State/RepairReconcileBackups manifest backup recorded in the command result.
